assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to capture any underlying rhythm disturbances.
CPT 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study.
CPT 93247 is medically necessary to document the rhythm disturbances underlying these symptoms.
The diagnosis codes Z86.73, G45.9, and I47.1 are associated with the patient's history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction and paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
